Read the hexagon x gene count matrix

Source: R/read.R
punkst_read_hex.Rd

Parses the sparse text file written by punkst_tiles2hex().

Usage

punkst_read_hex(hex)

Arguments

hex

A punkstHex object, or the path to the hex_*.txt file (the .json beside it is read for the gene dictionary).

Value

A list with units, a data frame of key, x, y, nfeat, total per hexagon, and counts, a sparse dgCMatrix (hexagons x genes) with gene names as column names.

Examples

d <- tempfile(); dir.create(d)
hex_txt <- file.path(d, "hex_0.txt")
writeLines(c("k1\t1.0\t2.0\t2\t3\t0 2\t1 1", "k2\t3.0\t4.0\t1\t1\t1 1"), hex_txt)
hex_json <- file.path(d, "hex_0.json")
jsonlite::write_json(list(dictionary = list(A0 = 0, B0 = 1)), hex_json, auto_unbox = TRUE)
punkst_read_hex(hex_txt)
#> $units
#>   key x y nfeat total
#> 1  k1 1 2     2     3
#> 2  k2 3 4     1     1
#> 
#> $counts
#> 2 x 2 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix"
#>      A0 B0
#> [1,]  2  1
#> [2,]  .  1
#>
